title: Bound private producer stderr in parent acceptance and policy read diagnostics
outcome: Parent acceptance and policy reads retain useful typed classification and safe causes without exposing private values from arbitrary producer stderr.
acceptance: Classify supported refusals, unsupported commands and genuine transport failures correctly while preventing synthetic credential/path values in arbitrary producer stderr from reaching parent/operator-visible diagnostics.

Behavioral raw-CLI coverage exercises parent request and policy readers, including successful reads and supported user-error codes; preserve evaluator recovery confidentiality and keep error ownership explicit.
